one thing that is extremely tricky with this top-down thought process...is not just all the puzzle pieces on mkt share, revs, fcf, but then translating them into equity value

meaning, u have to think about not just the revs --> FCF waterfall, but what multiple the market will capitalize the FCFs at for each respective company

you see this right now in all the moving pieces in the AI trade, as people try and figure out "wtf is the net effect of all this on the broad indices?"

it becomes so complex that u are prob best off recognizing it as a fool's errand

something like hyperscalers vs the pix'n'shovels...u see this back-and-forth pending newsflow, as market cap gets reshuffled around

one man's capex is another man's revenue, but CapexCo trades at 20x and ShovelCo trades at 5x

makes it very difficult to think about not just the value chain/profit pool and who is gaining at whose expense, but what this means for the stocks, the sector, and for ES/NQ

its that last step that people forget -- what multiple/discount rate to use when capitalizing FCFs -- in thinking about the big picture

and its prob why, if u were to ask the guys "seeing the ball well" right now -- like a sacerdote or gavin or leopold -- how much time they spend on this...my guess is they're entirely bottoms-up (while still using the framework in the QT), vs thinking about stuff like "what's the net effect of all this on some broad market index."
